# Ethixweb

> Premium Digital Operations, AI Automation & Web Architecture Agency.
> "We run the tech. You run the business."

Ethixweb (registered as Ethixweb USA LLC in Wyoming, United States) manages full-stack digital operations for growing businesses. Specializing in high-performance web architecture, AI voice/chat receptionists, CRM synchronization, SEO engineering, and paid acquisition.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Web Architecture & Redesign**: Headless modern React architectures, sub-second load times, Core Web Vitals 95+, bespoke architectural aesthetics.
- **AI Booking & Reception Agents**: Autonomous voice and chat agents handling 24/7 inbound enquiries, calendar bookings, and CRM synchronizations.
- **CRM & Pipeline Synchronization**: Multi-channel pipeline synchronization connecting websites, forms, and ad channels directly into Hubspot, Salesforce, or custom databases.
- **SEO & Organic Ranking**: Technical SEO, structured data integration, page speed optimization, and high-intent local/global search authority.
- **Paid Acquisition & Ads**: High-conversion Google Ads and Meta campaigns connected to end-to-end attribution analytics.
- **24/7 Digital Operations & Maintenance**: Dedicated engineering pods providing continuous uptime monitoring, security patching, and iterative feature development.
